name: Spatial Contrast Divergence Map
description: A lethal thermal light-radar designed to obliterate any irrational distribution of local spatial contrast. In authentic photography, spatial contrast transitions organically across depth planes due to optics and lighting decay. However, when a fraudster drops a brutally hyper-sharp, highly contrasted spliced object into an otherwise hazy, low-contrast background corner, this Contrast Map violently flags the unnatural 'tone-deaf' collision as a massive red anomaly.
mechanism: The image is sadistically shredded into thousands of 8x8 or 16x16 pixel micro-grids. The engine calculates the maximum divergence between the highest highlights and deepest shadows (Michelson/Weber contrast) inside every single block. It then constructs a forensic topographic heat map. An alien spliced object instantly renders as an illogical contrast 'cliff', shattering the surrounding laws of atmospheric haze and lighting diffusion.
parameters: Operator: Michelson Intensity Contrast, Extractor Grid: Dynamic 16x16 Spatial Blocks, Threshold Engine: Median Variance Divergence
accuracy: Solid (70-80%) - An incredibly effective 'lighthouse' scanner hunting down amateur Photoshop operators dragging and dropping objects across utterly conflicting lighting environments.
useCase: Acts as an impenetrable checkpoint guard, actively intercepting 'Lego-assembly' composites—like spliced faces, altered license plates, or disjointed elements projecting violently mismatched localized spatial contrast.

references.title: Barni, M., et al. (2010). Forensic analysis of digital images: Spatial contrast and inconsistency. IEEE TFS.
Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Krawetz, N. (2007). A Picture's Worth — Digital Image Analysis and Forensics.

strengths:
• Computationally blinding fast; client-side Canvas APIs sweep the entire grid matrix in fractions of a second.
• Instantly vaporizes sloppy, rush-job graphical splices that seamlessly bypass the naked human eye, particularly highly lethal against anomalous sharp boundaries.
limitations:
• Will go completely insane and fire massive false positives if scanning iPhone Cinematic mode portraits or heavy f/1.4 optical Bokeh shots, where natural optical falloff deliberately creates sudden and brutal contrast divergence.
• Completely neutralized and blinded if confronted by a deep-level manipulator actively mapping targeted Tone Curves to artificially crush the spliced object’s core contrast into environmental alignment.
